notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
Updated "Explosive paint" (now you can use a word you want, you can write a word)
 Updated "Penaties" game (Bugs solved)
 Updated Skins
 Fixed other bugs

notes.title: An update is coming
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/373ce05f78dfac1a1d69a53459689c4029a7f439.png
This is a small announcement to talk a little about the new big update that will be available soon.

The main element that makes up the future update is the new minigame that we'll add to the Little Fighters on Stream mini games catalog. This minigame is called "Explosive Paint"
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/57e6a6646ac4d509455b0f3c1c5cd6f0943d6561.png
Why that name?
You will know very soon, however for now we can tell you that it is a fun mini game in which the streamer must demonstrate his artistic skills and the chat interpret it.

Avatars
This update will come filled with the spirit of Halloween.
October is stained with horror and we propose a series of avatars that will be available in the soon update.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/26715a1e119582a47a0a5631ad85c309536f1dbd.png
This and much more (like improvements to some minigames), coming soon in the upcoming free Little Fighters on Stream update. 
Very soon available on Steam (we hope have the update available for next weekend).

notes.title: Minigames and news (Update v1.3)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/b3a4df7237d584d1605245620a994c3d291d85e6.png
We want to thank you all for playing Little Fighters on Stream.

The early access is going better than we expected and that makes us very happy. We're working on 2 new very funny mini games and with much more strategy and action, we hope to give more information about it soon.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/86f7791796340e28e223a5088882c95702dd25b4.png

We would like you to give us feedback on this publication or on our social networks (about proposals for new mini games or to notify us of bugs). Your reviews are extremely important to us. We wait for your comments!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/2c4299a26db59e664ffa4e7ff093fd89173683f6.png


 Fixed bugs: We fixed a couple of bugs present in mini game 1 and 2
 We have adjusted the minigame 3 "Juegardo": Now participants have much more precision since can throw the hoop even with decimal numbers, for example : !1.2 - !3.6 - !4.9 and so on. Where the highest intensity is still 5.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/c82baad71085f903d74bdf36aaecbc71a03fd922.png
 Small graphics update: specifically in menus and minigame 3.


Thanks for reading, all your comments are very welcome! :D
